testcase.name: shipped decoder has pinned identity, legal files and a scoped reproducible input inventory
frontend runtime source has no raw HTML, token access, browser credential storage or remote module imports
extended nutrient vocabulary has all 54 wire-domain keys and explicit mass/volume units
GTIN accepts only ASCII 8/12/13/14 with check digit and preserves the original string
camera cancellation stops a late permission stream and never starts decoding
camera errors are visible safe messages and acquired tracks stop when playback fails
diary loads HA-local today, shows unknown nutrients and dated goals, and navigates without timezone shifts
manual local search escapes product text, fetches detail, logs ml portions and saves favorite templates
quick entry stores total nutrients and edit/copy/delete target entry IDs
food entry editing scales immutable entry snapshot without fetching current food
custom food form keeps per100 ml values, omits unknown nutrients and saves a named serving
extended nutrients use explicit mg and microgram units without treating missing nutrients as zero
phone controls keep readable unbroken labels and compact adjacent online checkbox
real bundled ZXing decodes generated EAN13 pixels without BarcodeDetector
barcode manual input preserves leading zeros and scanner image input decodes pixels before lookup
disconnecting the panel releases camera tracks and closes scanner even without a decoded result
uncertain writes show a modal-safe explicit retry, retain request ID, and unlock only after success
actual getUserMedia video frames from Chromium virtual camera decode EAN and stop on result
pending diary date changes block writes and ignore late stale responses
commands use existing hass auth and preserve a write ID across uncertain explicit retry
known HA non-admin users are denied locally without sending private nutrition commands
definitive validation failure clears pending write so corrected input receives a new logical ID
